errorCodes.meaning: The caller is not the DID slot's current owner or an admin.
No slot exists under the submitted mnemonic.
The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain, or is inconsistent with the slot's recorded domain. See [category conventions](../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

createdAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the name was first bound to this DID.

enabled.description: Whether the name currently resolves. `false` means parked, not gone: the name still belongs to this DID and nobody else can claim it.

name.description: The name's local part, without the `@` — `alice` for `/@alice`. Bare rather than a full URL because a name is only meaningful within its domain, which is carried once on the response.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

agentNames.description: Every name bound to the slot, including parked entries. Always present — a slot with no names answers with an empty array, so a caller never has to distinguish 'no names' from 'field missing'.

domain.description: The slot's hosting domain. Omitted (rather than empty) for an un-domained legacy slot.

mnemonic.description: The slot the listing is for, echoed.
